title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15.5-Inch Iron - Pipeline Collection | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your kitchen organization with a wall mount paper towel holder that saves counter space while keeping a roll close at hand in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any kitchens.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
  • Iron construction with a highly durable powder coat for a clean, decorative finish
  • Color coordinated mounting hardware included
  • Limited lifetime warranty

Specs

  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Material: Iron
  • Overall size: 15.5 in L x 4 in W x 3 in H
  • Projection: 4 in
  • Product weight: 1.3 lb
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
  • Included: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No

Available in multiple designer finish options to coordinate with other Pipeline collection pieces.
